items.text: A group of students wanted to investigate the energy changes when salts dissolve in water. The teacher suggested that they should measure the temperature changes that occur when the salts were dissolved.

items.label: text
items.text: This is the method they followed:

items.label: list_item
items.text: Add 100 cm³ of water to a beaker.

items.label: list_item
items.text: Record the temperature of the water.

items.label: list_item
items.text: Weigh 5.00g of salt and add it to the water in the beaker.

items.label: list_item
items.text: Stir the mixture with a glass rod vigorously until all the solid has dissolved.

items.label: list_item
items.text: Record the maximum (or minimum) temperature of the solution.
